verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same and share the same faults. The headline still reads 'CONS TRUC TION', so the word stays broken in a banner that has room for it on one line. 'ORDER NOW' is tiny and too thin to read. The price sits after the button, which breaks the reading order. The X graphic and brick are crammed against 'Buy 2 only for', and the text sits on the graphic. A's brick is smaller and gets lost under the text. B's brick is slightly larger and reads better as the product, but it is just as cramped.
